phases.name: Nightly observation export exists end to end
phases.description: AP13: pure export core, real adapters, CDK declaration in WriteStack. Decision authority: docs/product/architecture/adr-observation-export.md. No deploy from this lane.

steps.name: Pure export core through the driving port: rows, day window, tile partitioning
steps.criteria: Scenarios tagged @step-01-01 green via focused run; one flat JSONL row per accepted report of the closed received_at UTC day; predicted lifted from receipt (null when absent); non-report items never exported; report received after 00:00Z excluded; keys log/observations/v1/dt=<date>/<tile>.jsonl.gz with tile = geohash4(seed lat/lon). Full suite of unit/property tests green.
steps.scenario_name: @step-01-01 tagged scenarios (focused run: npm run test:at -- --tags "@feature-f-observation-export and @step-01-01")
steps.implementation_notes: Functional core / imperative shell. New module home src/export/ (pure: item->row mapping, day-window selection on received_at, geohash4 tile partitioning reusing the publisher's geohash4, JSONL serialization; spot seeds parsed via the existing src/data/launch-spots.ts reader). Driving port runExport(deps) taking injected store ports (report-store read, object-store write) and an injected clock per src/pipeline/ports.ts rule — no ambient reads. Step definitions authored here (crafter-owned) against the driving port with in-memory/filesystem fakes; the filesystem storage twin src/pipeline/adapters/filesystem-store.ts provides real gzip + putIfAbsent semantics. Property tests default (fast-check in devDeps? verify; else example-based with rationale). Stored item shape is src/report/aws-write-store.ts reality: {pk REP#<id>, sk REPORT, report_id, device_id, received_at, credential_issued_at, record{...}, receipt{predicted,...}}.
steps.non_visual_rationale: Pure functions and a driving port writing S3-shaped objects through fakes; observables are stored objects and exit codes. No page, component, style, or pixel. U1-U7/U8 N/A.

steps.name: Abuse signals, write-once idempotency, gzip round-trip, real adapters + composition root
steps.criteria: Scenarios tagged @step-01-02 green; whole-suite npm run test:at green (feature complete at AT level); ops/abuse-signals/v1/dt=<date>.json carries the four 07 §7.4 signals; re-run writes nothing new and clobbers nothing; rows written under .gz keys read back as JSON lines through the house storage adapter; DynamoDB scan adapter integration-tested against DynamoDB Local (Docker, house precedent infra/test/aws-write-store.dynamodb.test.ts); composition root Lambda handler wired (env WRITE_STORE_TABLE + BUCKET_NAME, requiredEnv WHAT/WHY/HOW style).
steps.scenario_name: @step-01-02 tagged scenarios (focused run: npm run test:at -- --tags "@feature-f-observation-export and @step-01-02")
steps.implementation_notes: Signals pure in src/export/ (local day per spot-seed timezone; band_dispersion flags LOW variance across >=3 devices; interarrival/burst <500ms; mints_per_src_hash trailing 7d from CRED#/MINT items). Adapters: paginated Scan reader over the write store (read-only port exposing no write method, CallLogReader precedent); object writes through the existing S3 store adapter's putIfAbsent (reuse src/pipeline/adapters/s3-store.ts if its surface fits, per Reuse Analysis — extend, do not fork). Composition root per src/report/aws-lambda-adapter.ts style (lazy SDK import, memoized composition, thin handler). Add the new dynamodb-local integration test file to package.json test:infra (hardcoded list).
steps.non_visual_rationale: Adapters and a scheduled Lambda composition root; observables are DynamoDB reads, stored S3 objects and exit codes. No rendered surface. U1-U7/U8 N/A.

steps.name: CDK declaration in WriteStack: schedule, IAM, lockstep, infra tests
steps.criteria: npm run synth:infra green credential-free; npm run test:infra green; new infra assertions cover: scheduler.CfnSchedule cron(30 0 * * ? *) UTC targeting the export fn via a scheduler role; RC 1; timeout 120s; memory 512MB; explicit 14-day LogGroup; IAM exactly dynamodb:Scan+DescribeTable on the table ARN and s3:PutObject only on log/observations/v1/* and ops/abuse-signals/v1/* (no other write, no broader read); function roster/RC-sum/log-group lockstep updated deliberately.
steps.scenario_name: vitest template assertions (// covers: R7 R8) — cucumber N/A for infra per house style
steps.implementation_notes: WriteStack home per ADR Decision 1. The in-stack precedent is the LANDED notify job (infra/lib/write-stack.ts 'Notify' fn + 'NotifySchedule' + dedicated scheduler.amazonaws.com role, flexibleTimeWindow OFF, UTC cron) — copy that block's idiom including its packaging; additionally bundle data/spots seeds into the asset (copyLaunchSeedFiles precedent in ingest-stack bundling hook) because esbuild does not follow runtime readFileSync. Export values: cron(30 0 * * ? *), RC 1, timeout 120s, memory 512MB (write-declarations.ts gets exportReservedConcurrency/exportMemorySizeMb alongside the notify constants, per its header note). The frozen guardrail declaration 'timeout-notify-export: 120 seconds' already covers this job's timeout by design — do NOT edit guardrail-declarations.ts or any frozen fixture under tests/acceptance/*/fixtures/. Lockstep list (all in the same change): physical-names.ts functionNames entry (tenth function); infra/test/guardrails.test.ts declaredRealTimeouts + declaredRealReservedConcurrency + roster + log-group assertions; infra/lib/write-declarations.ts reservedConcurrencySum 14->15 with its quota-precondition comment updated; package.json test:infra gains infra/test/observation-export-wiring.test.ts.
steps.non_visual_rationale: Infrastructure-as-code and template assertions only. No rendered surface. U1-U7/U8 N/A.
